purpose: Versioned field contract for scientific claim/result nodes. This package holds pointers and metadata only; it is not a status database and does not promote mathematics.

orthogonal_axes.semantic_digest: H(canonical scientific content + typed deps). Digest match is never mathematical acceptance.
orthogonal_axes.evidence_digest: H(evidence identities). Separate from semantic content.
orthogonal_axes.verification_level: L0–L5 evidence metadata only; never CONTROLLING / acceptance.
orthogonal_axes.scientific_status: Owned exclusively by external authorities (claims firewall, Math- gate, math_status). Never derived from digests.

claim_id.notes: Stable identifier. Prefer existing claims/graph.json or Math- GRAPH.json IDs when bridging.

statement.notes: Statement text or pointer to the authoritative statement carrier. Not acceptance.

depends_on.notes: Typed dependency edges. Duplicate (target_id, relation) pairs are rejected. Edge presence here does not classify or promote either endpoint.

source_bindings.notes: Canonical source binding should include owner/repo/path plus immutable commit/blob/hash where available. Legacy string sources are crosswalked, not silently rewritten.

semantic_digest.notes: Derived H(claim_id + statement/version + scope/domain + source bindings + typed edges). Must be recomputed from content; a manually copied fingerprint cannot be the sole change detector. Digest match ≠ acceptance.

evidence_digest.notes: Derived H(evidence identities). Orthogonal to semantic_digest.

manual_fingerprint.notes: Optional legacy/manual fingerprint retained as provenance. Never the sole change detector; never scientific acceptance.

verification_level.notes: L0–L5 evidence metadata only. Level is never scientific acceptance or CONTROLLING promotion.

source_authority.notes: Must name an authority listed in AUTHORITY_MAP.json. This package never owns grades/statuses/classifications.

forbidden_owned_fields_reason: Those fields belong to external authorities (claims firewall, Math- hard gate, math_status registers). Duplicating them here would create a competing status store. Digests and verification_level never substitute for scientific_status.
change_detection_rule: Before/after comparison must seed impact from node semantic_digest (or complete source snapshot) OR outgoing-edge record changes, and must include the changed controlling node itself. Manual fingerprint alone is insufficient.
